system.description:
You may use this skill if your subclass is Mercenary, Outlaw, or Avenger.

You are in a [Riding: Giant Wolf] state. Also during the [Sitting: Giant Wolf] state, you can use the EX power "Beast dash" and "Wild stamp" in the Basic skills.

A feat that indicates that you have a large wolves you can ride. Wolves carry you on their backs and fight alongside you.
